_comment: Seed of the 'environment memory' (your RAG idea). In production this grows automatically as the tool observes the network. For now it's a tiny hand-written inventory of the lab so the agent can reason about WHAT an IP is, not just its number.

172.18.0.5.notes: The simulated adversary in the CerberusAI lab. Expected to generate hostile SSH traffic.

target-host.notes: Deliberately vulnerable target in the lab.

secure-db.notes: High-value asset holding production data. Should ONLY be reached by approved application hosts — never by the attack-simulator container. Any access attempt from an unexpected source is a serious lateral-movement indicator.

172.18.0.0/16.notes: Private container network; not the corporate LAN.
